 ERROR  no Sia app key
  The indexer issues one when you approve this installation. It
  is a secret: keep it out of shell history and never pass it as
  an argument.

 HINT   set SENNIT_APP_KEY to the key that approval issued
 HINT   not approved yet? `sennit connect --out sennit.key`
        issues one
 HINT   to work without an indexer, put `--offline` before the
        text: `sennit remember --offline --context "..." "..."`
